# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c25 P46](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0046), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is described as fat and possessed a natural gift for walking board fences. She wears dresses with flounces and evening dresses when attending school functions. She also wears her hair frilled and pompadoured.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c34 P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 c14 P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## Personality

Josie is sharp-tongued, defiant, and easily triumphant over others. She lacks imagination and can be malicious, catty, and sulky when she does not get her way. She lacks tact and scruples, often making spiteful or blunt remarks about others' appearances and backgrounds. Despite her disagreeable nature, she exhibits an airy unconcern, confidence, and a distinct lack of self-restraint or empathy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Goals

- To attend Queen's Academy for education's sake  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school, where she frequently cheated and engaged in rivalries with her classmates. She defied Anne Shirley by walking the Barrys' board fence and then dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Josie participated in school events, sulking when denied the role of Fairy Queen in a concert dialogue, and later won first prize for knitted lace at an exhibition. She joined the Queen's class organized by Miss Stacy and scraped through the entrance examinations by three marks. While attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, she earned a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student and boarder who frequented outings with Frank Stockley. After completing her first year at Queen's, she decided to return to the Academy for another year rather than teach.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
